page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c32g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The virtual machine delivers 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled, supported by 48 MB of Level 3 cache and vector extensions including AVX-512 and VNNI. System memory measures 188.0 GB, providing 5.88 GB of RAM per vCPU, and is paired with a baseline network bandwidth allocation of 16 Gbps under the KVM hypervisor.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by a single dedicated NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU equipped with 24 GB of VRAM. The instance includes no bundled local storage, necessitating external network-attached block storage for operating system images and persistent data. In benchmark evaluations, the NVIDIA A10 provides top-tier performance for smaller to mid-sized neural network workloads, processing 9,700 prompt tokens per second and generating 454.43 tokens per second on a 135M model, alongside 2,489.49 prompt tokens per second and 90.21 tokens per second during 7B model text generation.

General-purpose compute metrics place the 32-vCPU configuration within average tiers, achieving a PassMark CPU score of 36,547.02 and Geekbench 6 scores of 1,611 for single-core and 13,808 for multi-core. Large-block memory bandwidth sustains 126.91 GB/sec for reads and 53.4 GB/sec for writes. The hardware profile exhibits strong resource density for inference and graphic workloads that do not exceed 24 GB of GPU memory, balancing medium-scale machine learning efficiency against the lack of local scratch disks.

This instance profile fits artificial intelligence inference tasks, computer vision pipelines, media transcoding, and moderate deep learning fine-tuning. It also accommodates graphic rendering and scientific simulation workloads that benefit from combined x86 vector instructions and dedicated Ampere architecture acceleration.
